description: ASTRA-MED — A high-impact team of engineers and builders leveraging space data to solve complex technical challenges on Earth and beyond. We desire equal rights and medical data for everyone.
summary: We made health monitoring software for long-term astronauts. This software had two different modes: one was a summary mode and the other was a detailed mode. The astronauts are encouraged to use the summary mode for everyday use as it is fast. The astronauts are then encouraged to use the detailed mode for important tasks, such as regular health check-ups. We used Claude to make this software. We included an LLm agent that allows astronauts to complete simple tasks such as logging data and getting health advice. Our project solves the five issues of outer space in many ways.
details:
ASTRA-MED is an offline health monitoring tool for astronauts on long missions away from Earth, where messages can take 22 minutes. Crew members can record their health data including heart rate, blood pressure, sleep and radiation, and an application will generate a single status (NOMINAL, CAUTION or CRITICAL), and simple guidance. This is displayed via a clickable body diagram with reasoning for each recommendation. The trend alert feature will highlight if a reading is trending towards its limit, and alerts the crew 8 days before they would usually receive an alert in our demo. Space weather data from NASA DONKI and solar storm forecasts from WSA-ENLIL provide context for the radiation. Current positions of the planets from NASA JPL provide us with the current signal delay between Earth and Mars. On Tuesday we have a voice assistant to record health data, and Recharge which was inspired by the ‘don’t go crazy room’ from Project Hail Mary to show a view of Earth using NASA images, and rotating using hand gestures.

Benefits include giving crew autonomy whilst experiencing signal delays. Early alerts to any health concerns. Transparency as each step has the logic and source shown. It is completely offline and does not require an account. It can also be used by anyone who is far away from a Doctor, not just Moon/Mars crews. For example Antarctic stations, ships and Analog missions.

Our application was developed using Typescript, React, Vite, TailwindCSS, Recharts and Three.js. We have implemented hand tracking using MediaPipe. Our application can be run in the browser, as a windows/linux desktop application and a native iPad application. We have 223 automated tests. This application is innovative due to the early warning system, forecasting space weather for a Mars crew rather than Earth. Separating the environmental risk from the actual dose to the astronaut. Caring about the mental health of the crew member. We have designed this application with safety in mind. There are no diagnoses or medications given. All health data is labelled as synthetic. Prototypes thresholds have been used rather than NASA flight rules. We never use colours only. And it can be used without a network.
